evals.name: choose-abapgit-workflow-by-environment
evals.prompt: We have an on-premise SAP system and want to clone an existing Git repository into a development package with abapGit. Walk me through the key steps and what to verify before importing.
evals.expected_output: Gives an on-premise abapGit clone workflow, covers repository URL, target package and branch, and recommends reviewing incoming objects before activation.

evals.name: distinguish-gcts-from-abapgit
evals.prompt: Our team uses gCTS and SAP transports. Explain how that differs from abapGit; don't give me clone steps.
evals.expected_output: Explains the distinction between gCTS and abapGit and their place in ABAP Git workflows without treating the request as an abapGit clone task.
